Finding:
↑ Overall Survival
Increased Blautia abundance was strongly associated with improved overall survival (p < 0.001).

↑ Transplant-related Mortality
Low BCoAT copy numbers at D + 30/GvHD were significantly associated with increased risk of transplant-related mortality (HR 4.459; 95% CI 1.1018–19.530; p = 0.047).
